title: Force TLP AC mode
summary: Forces TLP to apply high-performance AC settings even if the laptop is running on battery. Useful for temporary performance boosts when not plugged in.

steps.explain: Apply TLP's AC-specific settings, ignoring the fact that the laptop might be on battery.

rollback.explain: Run 'sudo tlp bat' to switch back to battery settings, or 'sudo tlp start' to let TLP decide based on the actual power source.

warnings: This may drain the battery faster than usual.
